newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves 400,000 bales cotton for export-PTI.
newsitem.headline: India approves 400,000 bales cotton for export-PTI.

text.p: The Indian government has decided to authorise an additional export quota of 400,000 bales of staple cotton in the current year, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Tuesday.
The news agency did not say whether it was for the 1996/97 (April-March) fiscal year or the crop year that runs from October to September.
Out of the total amount released, the state-run Cotton Corporation of India (CCI) will supply 100,000 bales, PTI said.
The cooperative cotton growers' federations of the western states of Maharashtra and Gujarat will provide 50,000 bales each, it said.
Another 110,000 bales will come from general ginners. The remaining quota will come from various other sources including 50,000 bales from private traders, PTI said.
